questions.q: What does confirming a shipment finalize?
options: The customer's credit limit
The General Ledger period close
The actual shipped quantity against the delivery
The item's list price
questions.explain: Ship confirmation locks in the actual quantity that shipped, which can differ from what was planned.

questions.q: What happens to inventory when a shipment is confirmed?
options: It is depleted — removed from on-hand inventory at the ship-from organization
Nothing changes until the invoice is paid
It is automatically reordered
It is transferred to a different warehouse
questions.explain: Ship confirmation triggers inventory depletion because the goods are no longer physically on hand.

questions.q: What process does ship confirmation start that eventually makes a line eligible for invoicing?
options: Lockbox processing
AutoInvoice
Approval Management (AME)
Interface Trip Stop
questions.explain: Interface Trip Stop is the mechanism triggered by ship confirmation that makes shipment data available for the invoicing workflow.

questions.q: What is a common real-world consequence when a shipment physically leaves but is never confirmed in the system?
options: The order automatically self-corrects within an hour
The order sits stuck, inventory looks on-hand when it isn't, and the customer never gets billed
The customer's credit limit is automatically reduced
Nothing — ship confirmation is optional
questions.explain: An unconfirmed shipment leaves the order stuck, inventory inaccurate, and the customer unbilled for goods already received.

questions.q: Why is ship confirmation described as a "point of no return" for an ordinary quantity change?
options: Because the price list is locked forever
Because the customer's name can no longer be changed
Because after it, inventory has already left the books and invoicing has started, so a reduction needs a return instead of an edit
Because it has no real consequence
questions.explain: Once confirmed, the goods are physically gone and invoicing is underway, so correcting quantity requires a return process.
